opening.argument: The offer ties greater profit to paid slot activation and recruitment: viewers pay 25,000 or 50,000 rupees and bring people into twelve slots. Forsage is promoted as an Ethereum earning opportunity promising greater profit and passive income, alongside a displayed “$1,000,000 Profits” claim. A referral URL, WhatsApp group, contact number and “JOIN NOW” prompt turn those earnings claims into a direct invitation to participate. Together, the paid entry, recruitment structure and income pitch establish a recruitment-based scam promotion.

citations.quote: There are people who have activated the slot for 25000 or 50,000 rupees.
We can activate people who are with us for as much as we want, in our 12 slots.
So, in future, they will be able to get passive income for 3-6 months, business without losing money.
